# Storage Location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StorageLocation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A locus where digital objects reside — a cloud-storage folder, an object-store bucket, a filesystem path, a content-addressed store, or a physical disk. Its medium is a value ([`gmeow:storageMedium`](../properties/gmeow-storageMedium.md)); a physical device may sit at a geographic [`gmeow:physicalPlace`](../properties/gmeow-physicalPlace.md).

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md)
